description.en: Evidence-informed WHOLE adult Wiwaxia corrugata exterior reconstruction, nominal50mm long not a measured specimen replica. Smith2014 documents eight transverse rows and anterior organization; Zhang/Smith/Shu2015 explicitly reinterprets anterior organization in W.corrugata as ninth serial row, based also on adult ROM57707. Model uses eight trunk rows PLUS anterior paired fan; it does not falsely assert both authors use identical counting or impose juvenile W.papilio proportions/spine absence.2015 correction2023 adds omitted dataset only, not retraction. Molluscan versus deeper lophotrochozoan affinity remains uncertain. Colors, exact posture, body depth and soft margins inferred. Fine rib count simplified; no internal gut simulation, fossil scan or copied mesh.
